title: Outbound: how do concurrent Send clicks claim one draft so only one proceeds?
scope: The owner's Send click from two tabs, the sendAction server action, and the atomic Postgres claim on one message row.
omissions: Post-claim guards, Gmail/LinkedIn delivery and daily rate limits
Finding, research, enrollment and drafting of prospects

groups.label: Owner device
groups.description: Local browser, two tabs of one client

nodes.label: Browser tab A
nodes.description: Owner clicks Send on a draft

notes.title: Atomic claim
notes.text: After loadSettings, one UPDATE WHERE id, direction='out', status IN (draft,failed) sets sending, clears error, stamps sentAt/updatedAt, saves edits, RETURNING. No row → skipped.

notes.title: Not one-way
notes.text: After a win, failed guards set the row to failed or skipped, with sentAt null and an error. Failed rows can be claimed again by a manual Send. Skipped rows cannot.

notes.title: Crash after claim
notes.text: This only prevents duplicate claims. It does not guarantee delivery. A row left 'sending' can't be reclaimed. Refresh resolves only queued LinkedIn rows that have an externalId.
